title: spawn_node coordinates cast i64->i32 without a range check — out-of-range values silently wrap into bogus positions
detail: Coords parse as i64 then cast to i32 with no range check: 5000000000 wraps to 705032704, 2147483648 to -2147483648 (verified on the pinned toolchain), so out-of-range positions silently become bogus instead of failing loud.
recommended_fix: Range-check coords at parse and return the existing 'bad spawn_node position' error when x or y falls outside i32 (or the grid); never let an out-of-range value wrap into a silent bogus position.

category: memory lifetime / leak on error path
title: spawn_node type_name strings.clone'd entries leak when parse_demo errors out mid-file
detail: A spawn_node line before a later parse error clones type_name into the default allocator; parse_demo's return {}, err paths drop the Demo without freeing the clones — a bounded leak per malformed demo file.
recommended_fix: Free d.nodes' type_name clones (and dynamic slices) on every parse_demo error return before discarding d, or centralize cleanup so the error paths match run_demo's defer.
